overview.en: This chapter reviews macronutrients, vitamins, minerals and water, markers of malnutrition, healthy-eating guidance, nutrition across the life span, and each therapeutic diet (liquid, soft, fiber, cardiac, renal, protein-, sodium- and potassium-modified, and others), plus vegetarian diets and enteral feeding. Expect NCLEX items asking which foods a client should choose or avoid.
overview.zh: 本章複習巨量營養素、維生素、礦物質與水分、營養不良指標、健康飲食原則、各生命階段營養,以及各類治療性飲食(流質、軟質、纖維、心臟、腎臟、蛋白質/鈉/鉀調整等)、素食與管灌飲食。NCLEX 常考「患者應選擇或避免哪些食物」。

heading.zh: 營養素:醣類、脂肪、蛋白質

points.en: Carbohydrates (4 kcal/g) are the preferred fuel for brain and muscle; sources include milk, grains, fruits and vegetables.
points.zh: 醣類(4 kcal/g)是腦與肌肉偏好的能量來源;來源包括奶類、穀類、水果與蔬菜。

points.en: Fats (9 kcal/g) store energy, protect organs, keep body warm and carry fat-soluble vitamins; deficiency of essential fatty acids causes cold intolerance, skin lesions, infection risk and amenorrhea.
points.zh: 脂肪(9 kcal/g)儲存能量、保護器官、維持體溫並協助吸收脂溶性維生素;必需脂肪酸缺乏會導致怕冷、皮膚病變、易感染與閉經。

points.en: Proteins (4 kcal/g) build and repair tissue, balance fluids and acid-base, make antibodies, enzymes and hormones.
points.zh: 蛋白質(4 kcal/g)建構與修復組織、調節體液與酸鹼、製造抗體、酵素與荷爾蒙。

points.en: Complete proteins contain all essential amino acids; inadequate protein causes protein-energy malnutrition and wasting.
points.zh: 完全蛋白質含所有必需胺基酸;蛋白質不足會造成蛋白質熱量營養不良與肌肉脂肪消耗。

points.en: Pregnancy, lactation, infancy, childhood and adolescence have special needs; aging also changes needs.
points.zh: 懷孕、哺乳、嬰兒期、兒童期與青春期有特殊需求;老化也會改變營養需求。

points.en: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) are stored and can reach toxic levels; water-soluble (B vitamins, C) are excreted in urine.
points.zh: 脂溶性維生素(A、D、E、K)會儲存,過量可中毒;水溶性維生素(B 群、C)隨尿液排出。

points.en: Vitamin sources: B12 in meat/liver; folic acid in leafy greens and liver; C in citrus, tomatoes, broccoli; K in green leafy and cruciferous vegetables; thiamine in pork, legumes, nuts, whole grains.
points.zh: 維生素來源:B12 在肉類/肝臟;葉酸在綠葉蔬菜與肝臟;C 在柑橘、番茄、花椰菜;K 在綠葉與十字花科蔬菜;硫胺素(B1)在豬肉、豆類、堅果、全穀。

points.en: Mineral sources: calcium (dairy, tofu, greens); iron (red meat, liver, dried beans/fruits, fortified cereals); potassium (bananas, citrus, potatoes, melon, meats); magnesium (greens, nuts, legumes); sodium (table salt, processed foods).
points.zh: 礦物質來源:鈣(乳製品、豆腐、綠葉蔬菜);鐵(紅肉、肝臟、乾豆/乾果、強化穀片);鉀(香蕉、柑橘、馬鈴薯、哈密瓜、肉類);鎂(綠葉蔬菜、堅果、豆類);鈉(食鹽、加工食品)。

points.en: Water is 60-70% of body weight; survival without it is limited to a few days.
points.zh: 水佔體重 60-70%;缺水僅能存活數天。

heading.zh: 營養不良指標與健康飲食

points.en: Short-term protein status: retinol-binding protein, prealbumin, transferrin, creatinine, BUN. Long-term protein status: serum albumin. Nitrogen balance uses urinary urea.
points.zh: 短期蛋白質狀態:視黃醇結合蛋白、前白蛋白、運鐵蛋白、肌酸酐、BUN。長期蛋白質狀態:血清白蛋白。氮平衡以尿中尿素評估。

points.en: CBC with indices helps separate anemias from nutritional deficiencies.
points.zh: 全血球計數與紅血球指數有助區分貧血與營養缺乏。

points.en: Always assess ability to eat and swallow and support independence in eating.
points.zh: 務必評估進食與吞嚥能力,並盡量促進自行進食。

points.en: MyPlate/Dietary Guidelines teaching: half the plate fruits and vegetables, at least half of grains whole, low-fat milk, varied proteins, less sodium/saturated fat/added sugar, water instead of sugary drinks.
points.zh: MyPlate/飲食指南教導:半盤水果與蔬菜、至少一半穀類為全穀、低脂奶、多樣蛋白質、減少鈉/飽和脂肪/添加糖、以水取代含糖飲料。

points.en: Consider culture, spiritual beliefs and personal choices when planning diets.
points.zh: 規劃飲食時須考量文化、宗教與個人選擇。

points.en: Infants: breast/chest-feeding exclusively about 6 months; add new foods one at a time, 4-7 days apart; no cow's milk before 1 year; no honey or corn syrup before 1 year (botulism).
points.zh: 嬰兒:約 6 個月純母乳;新食物一次一種、間隔 4-7 天;1 歲前不喝牛奶;1 歲前不吃蜂蜜或玉米糖漿(肉毒桿菌風險)。

points.en: Toddlers: more than 24 oz milk/day risks milk anemia; avoid choking hazards (hot dogs, grapes, nuts, popcorn, candy, raw vegetables); finger foods build independence.
points.zh: 幼兒:每日牛奶超過 24 盎司有「牛奶貧血」風險;避免噎塞食物(熱狗、葡萄、堅果、爆米花、糖果、生菜);手抓食物可培養獨立。

points.en: School-age: watch high fat/sugar/salt snacks and childhood obesity; adolescents need more protein, calcium and iron and are at risk for eating disorders.
points.zh: 學齡兒童:留意高脂/糖/鹽零食與肥胖;青少年需要更多蛋白質、鈣與鐵,且是飲食障礙好發期。

points.en: Pregnancy: protein 60 g/day, more calcium, iron and folic acid. Lactation: about 500 extra kcal/day, plenty of fluids, avoid alcohol and caffeine.
points.zh: 懷孕:蛋白質每日 60 公克,增加鈣、鐵與葉酸。哺乳:每日約多 500 大卡、足量水分,避免酒精與咖啡因。

points.en: Older adults: lower energy needs, reduced taste, smell and thirst, dental changes; ensure calcium and vitamin D; discourage grapefruit with many medications.
points.zh: 老年人:能量需求下降、味覺嗅覺與口渴感減退、牙齒變化;確保鈣與維生素 D;許多藥物不宜與葡萄柚併用。

points.en: Clear liquid: water, broth, clear juice, gelatin, ice pops, carbonated drinks, tea/coffee; short-term only; deficient in calories and nutrients. Dairy and opaque juices are not clear; avoid red/purple dye before colon exams.
points.zh: 清流質:水、清湯、澄清果汁、果凍、冰棒、碳酸飲料、茶/咖啡;僅短期使用,熱量與營養不足。乳製品與不透明果汁不算清流質;腸道檢查前避免紅/紫色染料。

points.en: Weight change of 1 kg equals about 1 L of fluid gained or lost; monitor I&O and weight on liquid diets.
points.zh: 體重變化 1 公斤約等於 1 公升水分增減;流質飲食期間須監測輸出入量與體重。

points.en: Full liquid adds milk, ice cream, pudding, custard, strained soups and cereals; use supplements if used more than 3 days.
points.zh: 全流質加入牛奶、冰淇淋、布丁、卡士達、過濾湯品與精製穀粥;使用超過 3 天需營養補充品。

points.en: Mechanical soft: pureed, ground or chopped foods for chewing difficulty or dysphagia; avoid nuts, dried and raw fruits/vegetables, fried and tough meats.
points.zh: 機械軟質:將食物打泥、絞碎或切碎,適用咀嚼困難或吞嚥困難;避免堅果、乾果、生蔬果、油炸與粗硬肉類。

points.en: Soft diet: for mouth sores, oral surgery, jaw fracture, stroke; serve cooler foods for mouth sores; avoid nuts/seeds, raw produce, fried foods and whole grains; no straw for dysphagia.
points.zh: 軟質飲食:適用口腔潰瘍、口腔手術、下顎骨折、中風;口腔潰瘍給較涼的食物;避免堅果/種子、生蔬果、油炸與全穀類;吞嚥困難者不可使用吸管。

points.en: Low-fiber (low-residue) for IBD, partial obstruction, gastroenteritis, diarrhea: white bread, refined cereals, white rice, peeled potatoes; avoid raw fruits (except bananas), nuts, seeds, whole grains.
points.zh: 低纖維(低渣)飲食適用發炎性腸道疾病、部分腸阻塞、腸胃炎、腹瀉:白麵包、精製穀片、白飯、去皮馬鈴薯;避免生水果(香蕉除外)、堅果、種子、全穀。

points.en: High-fiber 20-35 g/day for constipation, IBS and asymptomatic diverticular disease; increase gradually with plenty of fluids; limit gas-forming foods.
points.zh: 高纖維每日 20-35 公克,適用便秘、大腸激躁症與無症狀憩室疾病;須漸進增加並大量喝水;限制易產氣食物。

points.en: Cardiac/DASH diet: restrict sodium, cholesterol and fats; fruits, vegetables, whole grains, low-fat dairy, fish, poultry, nuts.
points.zh: 心臟/DASH 飲食:限制鈉、膽固醇與脂肪;多吃蔬果、全穀、低脂乳品、魚、禽肉、堅果。

points.en: Fat-restricted diet for malabsorption, pancreatitis, gallbladder disease, GERD; fecal fat above 6-8 g/day indicates malabsorption.
points.zh: 限脂飲食適用吸收不良、胰臟炎、膽囊疾病、胃食道逆流;糞便脂肪每日超過 6-8 公克表示脂肪吸收不良。

points.en: High-calorie, high-protein diet for burns, cancer, HIV, COPD, wound healing; use calorie counts.
points.zh: 高熱量高蛋白飲食適用燒傷、癌症、HIV、COPD、傷口癒合;可做熱量計算。

heading.en: Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
heading.zh: 糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食

points.en: Carbohydrate-consistent diet (carb counting) for diabetes; Diabetes Plate: half nonstarchy vegetables, quarter lean protein, quarter complex carbohydrate, water.
points.zh: 固定醣類飲食(醣類計算)適用糖尿病;糖尿病餐盤法:一半非澱粉蔬菜、四分之一瘦蛋白質、四分之一複合醣類,飲水。

points.en: Sodium restriction for hypertension, heart failure, renal, liver disease: under 2,300 mg/day, ideally 1,500. Avoid processed, canned, smoked, pickled foods and effervescent medicines; salt substitutes contain potassium and are not for renal disease.
points.zh: 限鈉適用高血壓、心衰竭、腎臟與肝臟疾病:每日低於 2,300 mg,理想 1,500 mg。避免加工、罐頭、燻製、醃漬食品與發泡錠藥物;代鹽含鉀,腎病患者不可用。

points.en: Protein restriction (40-60 g/day) for renal disease and end-stage liver disease: use high-biological-value protein and enough calories so protein is not burned for energy.
points.zh: 限制蛋白質(每日 40-60 公克)適用腎病與末期肝病:選擇高生物價蛋白質並確保足夠熱量,避免蛋白質被當作能量。

points.en: Renal diet controls protein, sodium, phosphorus, calcium, potassium and fluids; peritoneal dialysis is less restrictive than hemodialysis. Weigh daily as the priority indicator of fluid status.
points.zh: 腎臟飲食控制蛋白質、鈉、磷、鈣、鉀與水分;腹膜透析比血液透析寬鬆。每日量體重是評估水分狀態的優先指標。

points.en: Thirst relief with fluid restriction: sugar-free gum or hard candy, frozen fluids, lemon in water, cold mouth rinse.
points.zh: 限水時緩解口渴:無糖口香糖或硬糖、冰凍液體、水中加檸檬、冷漱口水。

heading.en: Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets

points.en: Low-potassium diet for hyperkalemia (renal failure, Addison's, ACE inhibitors, K+-sparing diuretics): applesauce, green beans, cabbage, lettuce, grapes, blueberries.
points.zh: 低鉀飲食適用高血鉀(腎衰竭、愛迪生氏症、ACE 抑制劑、保鉀利尿劑):蘋果泥、四季豆、高麗菜、萵苣、葡萄、藍莓。

points.en: High-potassium diet for hypokalemia (diarrhea, vomiting, K+-depleting diuretics, Cushing's, steroids).
points.zh: 高鉀飲食適用低血鉀(腹瀉、嘔吐、排鉀利尿劑、庫欣氏症、類固醇)。

points.en: High-calcium diet for bone growth and osteoporosis prevention; lactose-intolerant clients need nondairy calcium sources.
points.zh: 高鈣飲食用於骨骼生長與預防骨質疏鬆;乳糖不耐者需攝取非乳製品鈣來源。

points.en: Low-purine diet for gout, kidney stones, high uric acid: avoid anchovies, herring, mackerel, sardines, scallops, organ meats, gravies, game.
points.zh: 低普林飲食適用痛風、腎結石、高尿酸:避免鯷魚、鯡魚、鯖魚、沙丁魚、干貝、內臟、肉汁、野味。

points.en: High-iron diet for anemia (organ meats, meat, egg yolk, whole wheat, dark leafy greens, dried fruit, legumes); take vitamin C with iron to improve absorption.
points.zh: 高鐵飲食適用貧血(內臟、肉類、蛋黃、全麥、深綠葉菜、乾果、豆類);鐵與維生素 C 併用可增加吸收。

points.en: Vegan: no animal products; lacto-vegetarian adds dairy; lacto-ovo adds dairy and eggs; ovo-vegetarian adds eggs only.
points.zh: 純素:不含任何動物性產品;乳素加乳製品;蛋奶素加乳製品與蛋;蛋素僅加蛋。

points.en: Possible deficiencies: energy, protein, vitamin B12, zinc, iron, calcium, omega-3, vitamin D; B12 is most likely lacking in vegans.
points.zh: 可能缺乏:熱量、蛋白質、維生素 B12、鋅、鐵、鈣、omega-3、維生素 D;純素者最容易缺乏 B12。

points.en: Teach complementary proteins across the day; eat iron plus vitamin C together; soy protein is comparable to animal protein.
points.zh: 教導一天內搭配互補蛋白質;鐵與維生素 C 同餐;大豆蛋白品質與動物性蛋白相當。

points.en: BMI = weight (kg) / height (m) squared.
points.zh: BMI = 體重(公斤)/ 身高(公尺)平方。

points.en: Enteral nutrition: for a working GI tract when oral intake is inadequate (dysphagia, burns, trauma, organ failure, severe malnutrition); use lactose-free formula for lactose intolerance.
points.zh: 管灌營養:適用腸胃道功能正常但口服攝取不足(吞嚥困難、燒傷、創傷、器官衰竭、嚴重營養不良);乳糖不耐者用無乳糖配方。

critical_points.en: Calories per gram: carbohydrate 4, protein 4, fat 9.
critical_points.zh: 每公克熱量:醣類 4、蛋白質 4、脂肪 9 大卡。

critical_points.en: Short-term protein status = prealbumin/transferrin; long-term = albumin.
critical_points.zh: 短期蛋白質狀態看前白蛋白/運鐵蛋白;長期看白蛋白。

critical_points.en: Vegans most often lack vitamin B12 (naturally found almost exclusively in animal products).
critical_points.zh: 純素者最常缺乏維生素 B12(天然來源幾乎僅存在於動物性食品)。

critical_points.en: Iron-deficiency anemia: iron foods plus vitamin C (oranges, leafy greens); avoid coffee and tea with iron foods.
critical_points.zh: 缺鐵性貧血:鐵質食物搭配維生素 C(柳橙、綠葉蔬菜);避免與咖啡、茶同時攝取。

critical_points.en: Clear liquids are transparent; dairy, pudding, custard and pureed foods are not.
critical_points.zh: 清流質為透明液體;乳製品、布丁、卡士達與泥狀食物不屬於清流質。

critical_points.en: Sodium limit under 2,300 mg/day (ideal 1,500); smoked, cured, canned and processed foods are high in sodium.
critical_points.zh: 鈉攝取每日低於 2,300 mg(理想 1,500);燻製、醃製、罐頭與加工食品含鈉高。

critical_points.en: Salt substitutes contain potassium; avoid in renal disease.
critical_points.zh: 代鹽含鉀;腎病患者避免使用。

critical_points.en: Renal/hemodialysis diet: limit sodium, potassium, phosphorus, fluid and (controlled) protein; weigh daily.
critical_points.zh: 腎臟/血液透析飲食:限制鈉、鉀、磷、水分並控制蛋白質;每日量體重。

critical_points.en: Protein restriction 40-60 g/day, but keep calories adequate and protein high biological value.
critical_points.zh: 限制蛋白質每日 40-60 公克,但須維持足夠熱量並選用高生物價蛋白。

critical_points.en: Infants: no honey or corn syrup under 1 year (botulism); no cow's milk before 1 year; introduce one new food every 4-7 days.
critical_points.zh: 嬰兒:1 歲前不給蜂蜜或玉米糖漿(肉毒桿菌);1 歲前不喝牛奶;每 4-7 天新增一種食物。

critical_points.en: Toddler choking hazards: hot dogs, grapes, nuts, popcorn, hard candy, raw vegetables.
critical_points.zh: 幼兒噎塞危險食物:熱狗、葡萄、堅果、爆米花、硬糖、生蔬菜。

critical_points.en: Pregnancy: protein 60 g/day, folic acid, iron, calcium. Lactation: +500 kcal/day, avoid alcohol/caffeine.
critical_points.zh: 懷孕:蛋白質 60 公克/日、葉酸、鐵、鈣。哺乳:每日多 500 大卡,避免酒精/咖啡因。

critical_points.en: Low-purine diet for gout/stones: avoid sardines, anchovies, herring, mackerel, organ meats, gravies.
critical_points.zh: 痛風/結石低普林飲食:避免沙丁魚、鯷魚、鯡魚、鯖魚、內臟、肉汁。

critical_points.en: Fiber diets: low-fiber for diarrhea/IBD/partial obstruction; high-fiber 20-35 g/day for constipation, introduced gradually with fluids.
critical_points.zh: 纖維飲食:腹瀉/發炎性腸病/部分阻塞用低纖維;便秘用高纖維每日 20-35 公克,須漸進並搭配水分。

critical_points.en: Dysphagia: assess swallowing, thicken liquids as prescribed, no straws; all clients: assess ability to eat and swallow.
critical_points.zh: 吞嚥困難:評估吞嚥、依醫囑增稠液體、不用吸管;所有患者皆須評估進食與吞嚥能力。

critical_points.en: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice alter absorption of many medications; discourage in older adults on prescriptions.
critical_points.zh: 葡萄柚與葡萄柚汁會改變多種藥物吸收;服藥的老年人應避免。

mnemonics.en: Fat-soluble vitamins: 'ADEK' (stored, toxic in excess); B and C are water-soluble (excreted).
mnemonics.zh: 脂溶性維生素「ADEK」(可儲存、過量中毒);B 群與 C 為水溶性(排出體外)。

mnemonics.en: Diabetes Plate: 1/2 nonstarchy vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 complex carbs.
mnemonics.zh: 糖尿病餐盤:1/2 非澱粉蔬菜、1/4 瘦蛋白質、1/4 複合醣類。

caption.en: Box 11.1: food sources of water-soluble and fat-soluble vitamins.
caption.zh: Box 11.1:水溶性與脂溶性維生素的食物來源。

caption.en: Box 11.2 food sources of minerals (calcium, iron, magnesium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, zinc) and Fig. 11.1 MyPlate.
caption.zh: Box 11.2 礦物質食物來源(鈣、鐵、鎂、磷、鉀、鈉、鋅)與圖 11.1 MyPlate。

caption.en: Box 11.3: nutrition from infancy to older adulthood, including choking hazards, pregnancy and lactation needs.
caption.zh: Box 11.3:嬰兒到老年的營養重點,包括噎塞風險、懷孕與哺乳需求。

caption.en: Box 11.4 gas-forming foods and Box 11.5 sodium-free spices for sodium-restricted diets.
caption.zh: Box 11.4 易產氣食物與 Box 11.5 限鈉飲食可用的無鈉香料。

caption.en: Clinical Judgment box: ways to relieve thirst in a client on fluid restriction.
caption.zh: 臨床判斷框:限水患者緩解口渴的方法。

stem.en: A client with iron-deficiency anemia is teaching back diet choices. Which selection shows understanding?
stem.zh: 缺鐵性貧血患者複述飲食選擇。哪一項顯示理解正確?

options.en: Oranges and dark green leafy vegetables

rationale.en: Dark green leafy vegetables supply iron and oranges supply vitamin C, which enhances iron absorption.
rationale.zh: 深綠葉菜提供鐵,柳橙提供維生素 C 以促進鐵吸收。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with malabsorption syndrome must avoid high-fat foods. Which foods go on the avoid list? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 吸收不良症候群患者須避免高脂食物。哪些食物應列入避免清單?(複選)

rationale.en: Margarine, cream cheese and luncheon meats are high in fat. Fruits, vegetables and broiled lean fish are low in fat.
rationale.zh: 人造奶油、奶油乳酪與午餐肉脂肪含量高;水果、蔬菜與烤瘦魚脂肪低。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client on hemodialysis for CKD needs menu teaching. Which menu choice shows understanding?
stem.zh: 血液透析的慢性腎病患者接受菜單教導。哪個選擇顯示理解?

options.en: Sausage and eggs, banana, orange juice
Cured pork, grits, strawberries, orange juice
options.zh: 醃豬肉、玉米粥、草莓、柳橙汁

rationale.en: The diet limits sodium, potassium, phosphorus and fluids. Cured meats are high in sodium; bananas, melon, tomato and orange juice are high in potassium.
rationale.zh: 飲食須限制鈉、鉀、磷與水分;醃製肉類含鈉高,香蕉、哈密瓜、番茄與柳橙汁含鉀高。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A postoperative client is on a clear liquid diet. Which items can the nurse provide? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 術後患者採清流質飲食。護理師可提供哪些食物?(複選)

rationale.en: Clear liquids are transparent. Pudding, vegetable juice and puree are not clear.
rationale.zh: 清流質為透明狀;布丁、蔬菜汁與蔬菜泥不是清流質。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client on a vegan diet needs teaching about which vitamin that is most likely lacking?
stem.zh: 純素飲食患者最可能缺乏哪一種維生素,需要加強教導?

rationale.en: B12 is found in animal products. A, C and E are plentiful in fruits and vegetables.
rationale.zh: B12 存在於動物性食品;維生素 A、C、E 在蔬果中含量豐富。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client has a serum sodium of 150 mEq/L. Which foods are acceptable? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 患者血鈉 150 mEq/L。哪些食物可以食用?(複選)

rationale.en: This is hypernatremia, so avoid sodium-rich processed foods such as cheese and processed cereals.
rationale.zh: 此為高血鈉,應避免高鈉的加工食品如起司與加工穀片。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with hypokalemia asks about potassium-rich foods. Which should the nurse include? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 低血鉀患者詢問高鉀食物。護理師應包括哪些?(複選)

rationale.en: Raisins, potatoes, cantaloupe and strawberries are potassium sources; peas and cauliflower are higher in magnesium.
rationale.zh: 葡萄乾、馬鈴薯、哈密瓜與草莓含鉀;豌豆與白花椰菜含鎂較多。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A mother asks when she may add honey to her 8-month-old's cereal. What is the best response?
stem.zh: 母親詢問何時可在 8 個月大嬰兒的麥糊中加蜂蜜。最佳回應為何?

options.en: "Wait until your baby is at least 1 year old because of the risk of botulism."
options.zh: 「須等到至少 1 歲,因為有肉毒桿菌中毒風險。」

rationale.en: Honey and corn syrup products are avoided before age 1 because of the risk of botulism toxin.
rationale.zh: 1 歲前應避免蜂蜜與玉米糖漿產品,因有肉毒桿菌毒素風險。
